articles.title: Cypherpunk launches Zcash mining fleet controlling 18% of network hashrate
articles.snippet: The $33.3 million Winklevoss Capital deal expands Cypherpunk’s ZEC strategy as it targets 5% ownership of the cryptocurrency’s circulating supply.

articles.title: Winklevoss-Backed Cypherpunk Launches 'World's Largest' Zcash Mining Fleet
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed privacy firm launched Cypherpunk Mining through a $33.33 million equity deal with Winklevoss Capital, adding roughly 18% of the Zcash network's hashrate to accelerate its treasury ambitions.
